items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1957-03-26
items.q: Yes, I know Hardy. No, I never played with Hardy. He never played with me.

ctx.x: Well, he had a band across the river with Emmett Hardy. Hardy? You remember Hardy?

Yes, I know Hardy. No, I never played with Hardy. He never played with me. But I had a band over there before Hardy, long, long before Hardy. Now, Hardy seemed to be a pretty good fella, pretty good kid.
That's about all I wanted to ask about. We don't want to take up too much of your time.
